transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I'm here today because I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past five months. It just feels like a constant heaviness that I can't shake off, and I really need some help.

Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—such as having unusually high energy, needing very little sleep, or feeling extremely wired and on top of the world?

Yes, I actually had a period like that in the past that lasted for about a month. I felt an immense surge of energy, was constantly on the move, and felt extremely happy and on top of the world. It was the complete opposite of how depressed and empty I feel now.
During those high-energy periods or even during your low periods, did you ever hear or see things that others couldn't, or hold very strong beliefs that others felt weren't true?

Yes, during that high-energy month, I heard voices that weren't there and felt like I had special powers and was being watched. But those experiences only happened when I was in that high state. Since I've been depressed these past five months, all of those things have completely stopped.
To be sure, have you ever experienced those voices or feelings of being watched during times when your mood felt completely normal—neither high nor depressed—for at least two weeks?

No, absolutely not. I only hear those voices and feel like I'm being watched when my mood is extremely high and energetic. When my mood is normal, or even when I'm feeling down, those experiences never happen.
